data.answer: DHL awarded the Ultimate Small Business INDYCAR Sweepstakes prize to FLATED, a company founded in 2021 by Monique Keefer, Ken Hoeve, Dan Watts, and Ryan Guay. FLATED offers lightweight, inflatable truck toppers and vehicle accessories. The company ships nationwide and has growing international distribution in several countries. A user review on Maverick Truck Club praised the installation and satisfaction with the Flated Topper. FLATED.ca sells inflatable truck toppers and truck accessories in Canada.

results.title: DHL awards Ultimate Small Business INDYCAR Sweepstakes prize to FLATED
results.content: In just a few years, FLATED has earned significant national recognition, including an appearance on Shark Tank, a spot on TIME Magazine’s list of Best Inventions, and multiple Specialty Equipment Market Association (SEMA) awards. Now, the company ships nationwide through its online storefront and an expanding retail dealer network, with growing international distribution in Canada, Argentina, Chile, Paraguay, New Zealand, and Southern Africa. [...] Founded in 2021 by outdoor industry veterans Monique Keefer, Ken Hoeve, Dan Watts and Ryan Guay, FLATED was born in the surf-centric community of Carlsbad, California, with a mission to solve a common challenge for road trippers and truck owners: the storage, weight and hassle of traditional fiberglass truck caps and rooftop cargo boxes. Today, the company offers an innovative line of lightweight, inflatable truck toppers and vehicle accessories that are durable, tool-free to install and easy [...] Following the random drawing, DHL learned that FLATED was already using DHL's international shipping services to support its product development and global expansion. DHL's speed-to-market advantage has enabled FLATED to quickly deliver prototypes to its team and international partners, allowing the company to test, refine, and launch vehicle-specific products ahead of many competitors in the space.
